[{"id":"R02854","os_target":"Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) via ARM TrustZone; OP-TEE Trusted Kernel system calls","llm_role":"unknown","security_task":"Fuzz TrustZone-assisted TEE to uncover deep-seated TEE bugs and crashes","evidence":"we present a fuzzing strategy for TrustZone-assisted TEE that utilizes inferred dependencies between Trusted Kernel system calls to uncover deep-seated TEE bugs","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"No LLM is mentioned anywhere in the title or abstract, so the LLM-role dimension is unknown; TEE security work alone does not satisfy the LLM criterion."},
{"id":"R02902","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Evaluated system that executes natural-language instructions and must satisfy a strict JSON output contract","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"we analyze how instruction-preserving paraphrases-prompts that retain identical task semantics and constraints-affect the reliability with which LLMs execute structured instructions","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"No OS component or security task is stated; the study measures prompt and execution robustness rather than OS security."},
{"id":"R02916","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Performs path-based symbolic execution reasoning directly over code instead of theorem provers or SMT solvers","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"a novel approach that enhances LLM inference via a path-based decomposition of the program analysis tasks into smaller (more tractable) subtasks","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Language-agnostic program-analysis tool; no OS component and no security objective is established."},
{"id":"R02960","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Classifies vulnerability-fixing patches/commits alongside a fine-tuned BERT message classifier","security_task":"Vulnerability-fixing commit classification","evidence":"a large language model  LLM  is employed to address the challenges posed by the variant code language and length","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"No OS component; security relevance is limited to vulnerability-commit triage and is not tied to OS security."},
{"id":"R03021","os_target":"Network Function Virtualization (NFV) architecture and virtualized network functions","llm_role":"unknown","security_task":"Address NFV security challenges (topology risks, complex layers, malicious insiders) via encryption/authentication, standardized interfaces, and Zero Trust","evidence":"NFV also encounters several security challenges. This study will cover the issues of topology risks, complex layers, and malicious insiders.","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"No LLM involvement; NFV is a network-virtualization layer not established as an OS component or privileged OS interface."},
{"id":"R03222","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Six LLMs analyzed earnings call transcripts to construct a model-disagreement measure","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"We develop a novel LLMD measure by employing six cutting-edge LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, and Qwen-2.5) to analyze a comprehensive collection of earnings call transcripts.","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Finance/economics study; no OS component or security task, and LLMs are used as measurement instruments."},
{"id":"R03336","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"GPT-based LLM detects and resolves log anomalies and generates actionable recommendations","security_task":"Real-time log anomaly detection for system security and stability","evidence":"using large language models (LLMs) to detect and resolve anomalies in real-time","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"System logs are input data; no specific OS component is named and security monitoring is only implied."},
{"id":"R03364","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Fine-tuned BERT language model scores top-k token prediction to flag anomalous logs","security_task":"Log anomaly detection for security and stability monitoring","evidence":"The LogFiT model uses a pretrained BERT-based language model fine-tuned to recognise the linguistic patterns of the normal log data.","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"System logs are input data; the abstract names no OS component and does not operationalize a security task."},
{"id":"R03368","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Fine-tuned BERT language model scores top-k token prediction to flag anomalous logs","security_task":"Log anomaly detection for security and stability monitoring","evidence":"The LogFiT model uses a pretrained BERT-based language model fine-tuned to recognise the linguistic patterns of the normal log data.","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Duplicate record; no OS component is named and security relevance is limited to generic log monitoring."},
{"id":"R03391","os_target":"Cloud container deployments","llm_role":"unknown","security_task":"Containerization security risks","evidence":"Containerization Security: Addressing Risks in Cloud Container Deployments","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Abstract duplicates the title only; no method, LLM role, or specific OS component can be established."},
{"id":"R03586","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Tool-using LLM agent within an offline expert system, constrained by deterministic decision gates","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"it went from a single-model prototype, through a digital twin that was deliberately torn down, to a tool-using agent","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Industrial foundry root-cause analysis; no OS component or security task is stated."},
{"id":"R03590","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"unknown","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"The data currently used from Build Test Automation from Jenkins Pipeline.","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Abstract is a single sentence about Jenkins pipeline test data; no LLM, OS component, or security task is established."},
{"id":"R03594","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"unknown (machine-learning techniques, not explicitly an LLM)","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"This bot will analyze the failure logs, error message, descriptions, error codes and apply the machine learning (ML) techniques to predicts the root cause of the failure","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"CI test-failure root-cause automation; no LLM is named and no OS component or security task is present."},
{"id":"R03596","os_target":"CI/CD pipeline infrastructure (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes)","llm_role":"LLM-assisted root-cause analysis plus multi-agent planner/executor recovery","security_task":"unknown (safe remediation appears operational rather than security)","evidence":"The framework integrates Jenkins webhook events, log-based failure classification, Large Language Model-assisted root cause analysis, multi-agent recovery planning, safe remediation execution","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"CI/CD automation is not established as an OS component; safe remediation concerns operational safety and no security task is specified."},
{"id":"R03677","os_target":"Firewall/network security configurations from six vendors","llm_role":"LLM-driven auditing and NIST SP 800-53 control mapping with RAG","security_task":"Firewall configuration auditing and SOC alerting","evidence":"We propose Network Security Configuration Audit Tool (NSCAT), an LLM-driven methodology that normalises six-vendor configurations into a 34-field Canonical Data Model (CDM), audits them with 36 LLMs across six providers","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Network firewall configuration is a security control but not an OS component; if broad privileged interfaces qualify it could be adjacent, but OS scope is not established."},
{"id":"R03714","os_target":"Privileged access control (identity and entitlement data)","llm_role":"Synthesizes evidence-anchored, requirement-aligned audit narratives under human oversight","security_task":"Cybersecurity auditing of privileged access control","evidence":"The improvement is primarily driven by faster synthesis and a more consistent, requirement-aligned narrative structure, while final compliance judgements remain explicitly human.","suggested":"possible_core","uncertainty":"Privileged access control is named only as a case study; whether it constitutes an OS component or privileged interface is not fully established."},
{"id":"R03844","os_target":"Windows OS forensic artifacts from disk images","llm_role":"Reasons over indexed evidence via cloud or local LLMs with retrieval anchors and anti-hallucination constraints","security_task":"Forensic investigation of ransomware, backdoor, and insider exfiltration cases","evidence":"This paper presents ArshaLab, an open and modular platform for LLM-assisted Windows forensic investigation","suggested":"possible_core","uncertainty":"Windows is clearly named, but this is an application-level forensic platform rather than an OS component; core fit depends on counting digital forensics as OS security."},
{"id":"R03933","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Gemini prediction files compared against a rule-based Sanskrit suffix classifier","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"This exploratory study evaluates a Python suffix classifier and supplied Gemini prediction files for 100 Bhagavad Gita entries","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Linguistics study; no OS component or security task is present."},
{"id":"R03939","os_target":"unknown","llm_role":"Claude translated, reimplemented, and optimized a nonlinear FEA program under author guidance","security_task":"unknown","evidence":"The large language model Claude (Anthropic) was guided by the author to translate, reimplement, and optimise a nonlinear finite element analysis (FEA) program","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"Scientific-software engineering case study; no OS component or security task is stated."},
{"id":"R04047","os_target":"unknown (road network infrastructure, not a computer OS)","llm_role":"Multi-agent LLM pipeline with requirement thinker, strategy maker, and vulnerability analyst modules","security_task":"Road network vulnerability analysis","evidence":"we propose an automated LLM-based multi-agent pipeline for road network vulnerability analysis","suggested":"unclear","uncertainty":"'Vulnerability' refers to transportation-network reliability, not computer or OS security; no OS component is involved."}]
